company_overview: Postman provides an API platform that lets teams design, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services. It streamlines every stage of the API lifecycle and enables collaboration at enterprise scale.
target_audience: Developers and engineers who build, test, and operate APIs, especially within enterprise environments.

company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source platform that offers a fully managed Postgres database with built‑in authentication, realtime sync, storage, edge functions, vector embeddings and auto‑generated REST/GraphQL APIs. It enables developers to launch full‑stack applications quickly and scale them to millions of users.
target_audience: Developers building full‑stack applications, AI builders, and enterprise or innovation teams that need a production‑ready Postgres backend.

company_overview: Vapi provides a platform to build, deploy, and manage advanced voice AI agents, handling the underlying infrastructure for users. It offers real‑time monitoring, integrations, and enterprise‑grade compliance features for large‑scale deployments.
target_audience: Developers and product teams building voice AI agents for enterprise applications and large‑scale customer‑facing use cases
